meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 在升级 NanoClaw 时,先检查你的工作区并创建回滚点,然后提取你对代码的改动(配置、源码、技能等),整理成一份可重放的迁移指南,再在干净的上游代码上重新应用这些自定义,避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求升级 NanoClaw 到上游新版本、想把 fork 上的改动提取成迁移指南,或已有指南时要求直接跳过提取开始重放时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取 NanoClaw 的本地改动,生成一份迁移指南。
say.note: Claude 会先做预检,然后分析改动并和你确认。

say.text: 帮我看下改动规模,决定用完整迁移还是轻量升级。
say.note: Claude 会评估分歧等级,推荐最合适的路线。

say.text: 我已经有迁移指南了,直接开始升级吧。
say.note: Claude 会跳过提取,按指南重新应用改动。

howto.what_en: This skill turns NanoClaw upgrades into intent-based migration: it inspects the working tree, creates a rollback point, extracts your customizations into a replayable guide, then re-applies them on a clean upstream checkout instead of merging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to upgrade NanoClaw to upstream, wants customizations extracted into a guide, or asks to skip straight to reapplying from an existing guide.

say_en.text: Extract my NanoClaw changes and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Claude runs preflight then analyzes changes with you.

say_en.text: Check how big my changes are and recommend the migration path.
say_en.note: It assesses divergence tier and offers the lightest route.

say_en.text: I already have a migration guide; start the upgrade.
say_en.note: Skips extraction and reapplies from the guide.
